verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API, but it is described only as assigning users to variants for experiments, rollouts and releases. That is runtime evaluation, not flag management. The hosted MCP server is documented, but its listed tools cover querying data and creating dashboards, with no flag tools mentioned. Mixpanel does position itself as a place to run tests and rollouts, so the flag capability exists, but agent-driven management is not shown. Missing for 10: API or MCP endpoints to create flags, set targeting rules, and toggle flags on or off; MCP tools for flags; hands-on corroboration.
